# Bank of America

> Bank of America provides consumer banking, credit cards, lending, home loans, digital banking, and Merrill investing services.

Bank of America serves personal banking customers with deposit accounts, cards, loans, mortgages, digital tools, branch access, security resources, and financial education. Its website also connects customers to Merrill investing, account support, and location-based services.

## Personal Banking
- [Bank of America Home](https://www.bankofamerica.com/): Main entry point for banking, cards, loans, and investing services.
- [Checking Accounts](https://www.bankofamerica.com/deposits/checking/checking-accounts/): Compare Bank of America Advantage Banking checking account options and features.
- [Savings Accounts](https://www.bankofamerica.com/deposits/savings/savings-accounts/): Explore savings account options, rates, and account-opening information.
- [Certificates of Deposit](https://www.bankofamerica.com/deposits/cd/certificate-of-deposit-accounts/): Review CD account options, terms, and deposit account details.
- [Bank of America Advantage Banking](https://www.bankofamerica.com/deposits/checking/bank-of-america-advantage-banking/): Overview of the bank’s primary checking product family.
- [Debit Cards](https://www.bankofamerica.com/deposits/debit-card/): Learn about debit card features, digital wallet use, and card controls.

## Credit Cards
- [Credit Cards](https://www.bankofamerica.com/credit-cards/): Browse and compare personal credit cards by rewards, cash back, and travel benefits.
- [Cash Back Credit Cards](https://www.bankofamerica.com/credit-cards/cash-back-credit-cards/): Compare cards focused on cash back rewards and everyday spending.
- [Travel & Airline Credit Cards](https://www.bankofamerica.com/credit-cards/travel-credit-cards/): Explore travel rewards cards and airline-related card options.
- [Balance Transfer Credit Cards](https://www.bankofamerica.com/credit-cards/balance-transfer-credit-cards/): Find cards designed for introductory balance transfer offers.
- [Secured Credit Cards](https://www.bankofamerica.com/credit-cards/secured-credit-cards/): Review secured card options for building or rebuilding credit.
- [Credit Card Customer Service](https://www.bankofamerica.com/customer-service/contact-us/credit-card/): Access support resources for Bank of America credit card accounts.

## Loans & Credit
- [Auto Loans](https://www.bankofamerica.com/auto-loans/): Learn about new, used, refinance, and lease buyout auto financing.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://www.bankofamerica.com/auto-loans/auto-loan-calculator/): Estimate monthly payments and financing scenarios for vehicle purchases.
- [Personal Loans Overview](https://www.bankofamerica.com/personal-loans/): Information about personal lending availability and related borrowing alternatives.
- [Home Equity](https://www.bankofamerica.com/mortgage/home-equity/): Review home equity line and borrowing information where available.
- [Student Banking & Student Cards](https://www.bankofamerica.com/student-banking/): Banking and card resources tailored for students and young adults.

## Home Loans
- [Mortgages](https://www.bankofamerica.com/mortgage/): Entry point for mortgage products, calculators, and homebuyer resources.
- [Home Mortgage Loans](https://www.bankofamerica.com/mortgage/home-mortgage/): Explore mortgage options for buying a home or refinancing.
- [Mortgage Refinance](https://www.bankofamerica.com/mortgage/refinance/): Review refinance options, rates, and application guidance.
- [Affordable Loan Solution Mortgage](https://www.bankofamerica.com/mortgage/affordable-loan-solution-mortgage/): Learn about a low down payment mortgage option.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.bankofamerica.com/mortgage/mortgage-calculator/): Estimate monthly mortgage payments and home affordability.
- [Home Loan Navigator](https://www.bankofamerica.com/mortgage/learn/home-loan-navigator/): Digital mortgage application and loan-tracking platform information.

## Digital Banking
- [Online Banking](https://www.bankofamerica.com/online-banking/): Overview of online banking features for managing accounts and payments.
- [Mobile Banking App](https://www.bankofamerica.com/online-banking/mobile-and-online-banking-features/): Learn about mobile app capabilities, alerts, deposits, and transfers.
- [Mobile Check Deposit](https://www.bankofamerica.com/online-banking/mobile-and-online-banking-features/mobile-check-deposit/): Details on depositing checks through the mobile banking app.
- [Bill Pay](https://www.bankofamerica.com/online-banking/mobile-and-online-banking-features/bill-pay/): Information on paying bills online and through mobile banking.
- [Zelle](https://www.bankofamerica.com/online-banking/mobile-and-online-banking-features/send-money-with-zelle/): Send and receive money with Zelle through Bank of America.
- [Digital Wallet](https://www.bankofamerica.com/online-banking/mobile-and-online-banking-features/digital-wallet/): Use Bank of America cards with supported digital wallet services.

## Investing & Merrill
- [Merrill Overview](https://www.bankofamerica.com/investing/merrill-edge/): Bank of America entry point to Merrill self-directed and advisory investing.
- [Merrill Edge](https://www.merrilledge.com/): Merrill’s investing platform for self-directed and guided investing.
- [Retirement & IRAs](https://www.merrilledge.com/retirement/overview): Explore retirement investing accounts and IRA options through Merrill.
- [Guided Investing](https://www.merrilledge.com/investing/merrill-guided-investing): Learn about managed investing and advisor-supported portfolio options.
- [Preferred Rewards](https://www.bankofamerica.com/preferred-rewards/): Relationship rewards program linking banking and eligible Merrill balances.
- [Private Bank](https://www.bankofamerica.com/private-bank/): Wealth management and private banking services for high-net-worth clients.

## Security & Account Support
- [Security Center](https://www.bankofamerica.com/security-center/overview/): Central hub for fraud prevention, privacy, and account protection resources.
- [Online & Mobile Banking Security Guarantee](https://www.bankofamerica.com/security-center/online-mobile-banking-privacy/): Information on digital banking protections and customer responsibilities.
- [Report Suspicious Communications](https://www.bankofamerica.com/security-center/report-suspicious-communications/): Guidance for reporting phishing, scams, and suspicious messages.
- [Privacy & Security Help](https://www.bankofamerica.com/security-center/privacy-overview/): Learn how customer information is protected and managed.
- [Contact Us](https://www.bankofamerica.com/customer-service/contact-us/): Customer service directory for banking, cards, loans, and account help.
- [Help Center](https://www.bankofamerica.com/customer-service/): Support hub for common questions and service topics.

## Locations & Appointments
- [Financial Centers and ATMs Locator](https://locators.bankofamerica.com/): Find nearby Bank of America branches, drive-thrus, and ATMs.
- [Schedule an Appointment](https://secure.bankofamerica.com/secure-mycommunications/public/appointments): Book time with banking, lending, or investing specialists.
- [ATM Services](https://locators.bankofamerica.com/atm/): Search for ATM locations and available self-service features.
- [Financial Center Services](https://locators.bankofamerica.com/financial-centers/): Search branch locations and review in-person banking services.

## Financial Education
- [Better Money Habits](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en): Financial education hub with articles, videos, and practical money guidance.
- [Budgeting](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/saving-budgeting): Educational content on budgeting, saving, and spending decisions.
- [Credit](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/credit): Learn about credit scores, borrowing, and responsible credit use.
- [Home Ownership](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/home-ownership): Resources for buying, financing, and owning a home.
- [Retirement Planning](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/retirement-planning): Articles and tools for retirement saving and long-term planning.
- [Life Events](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/life-events): Financial guidance organized around major personal and family milestones.
